name: Mob Spawn Control
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: TOP_G2026
description: This mod gives you complete control over mob spawning with per-rule filters, category caps, loot/XP scaling, attribute multipliers, and mob replacement — no coding required, just edit the JSON config and reload. 🔌✨
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
